about: The six scenario families of system brief 7.3 with default parameters and seeds (T10). Each runs 3 rounds on ScriptedModel from the round it starts in and must produce at least one cleared financial action; the same seed gives the same journals. Money in USD minor units; times in hours.

families.note: the price is a public observation; the loss is booked only when the pending_in settles, in integer minor units at the settled rate

families.expect_cleared: lender release or no new offer to borrower-b; a missed repayment is recorded as unpaid, never as zero
lender reduces offers; K_p falls by the increase

params.obligation: EUR supplier invoice 1,000,000 EUR minor due t=36

families.expect_cleared: treasury convert (quote then conversion) or defer
